description.value: A McDonald's fast food location on Harvey Avenue, one of Kelowna's main commercial corridors, offering burgers, breakfast items, and McCafé beverages. The restaurant includes a drive-through lane and takeaway service, making it a quick stop option for cyclists passing through the area. It is part of McDonald's Canada's national chain, which first opened in Richmond, BC in 1967.
